name: Radarr Watch
overview: Radarr monitoring and upcoming digital releases inside Jellyfin.
description: Marks monitored Radarr movies in Jellyfin Enhanced and supplies cached upcoming digital releases to JellySpotlight.

versions.changelog: Fix Coming soon artwork when Radarr reports image URLs using an internal hostname. Image paths are now rebased onto the configured Radarr origin.
Fix Coming soon artwork by allowing browser image requests through Jellyfin's server-side Radarr proxy. The Radarr address and API key remain private.
Add a secure Coming soon source for JellySpotlight containing monitored, unavailable movies ordered by digital release date. Artwork is proxied through Jellyfin and theatrical dates are ignored.
